ABOUT THE INSTITUTE
The Institute is affiliated to the State University of Health
Sciences and follows its academic calendar.

PROGRAMMES
B.Sc. Medical Laboratory Technology: duration of the course is
three years and six months of internship.
Eligibility criteria: 10+2 with Physics, Chemistry and Biology.
Medium of instruction: English.

COURSE CONTENT
Semester wise scheme of examination is notified by the university
before the start of each academic year. Programme outcomes are
mapped to course objectives in the curriculum document.
